svg.title: Reducing a combination of series and parallel resistors
svg.desc: Five circuits connected by arrows. First: a source feeds R1, then R7 to the bottom wire, then R2, R3 and R4 in parallel (circled as Rp), then R5 and R6 in parallel (circled as Rp′). Second: Rp and Rp′ replace those groups and are circled together as their series sum Rs. Third: R7 and Rs are circled as their parallel combination Rp″. Fourth: R1 and Rp″ are circled as their series sum Rs′. Fifth: the source drives the single equivalent resistance Rs′.
